from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyArRecord(BaseModel):
    """Accounts Receivable figure reported in one company's filing."""
    company: str = Field(description="Company name from the filing")
    accounts_receivable_amount: str | None = Field(description="Accounts Receivable amount as written in the filing (e.g. '28,160') or None if not disclosed")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of the amount (e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars')")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="Period end date for this filing")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text showing the Accounts Receivable line or its absence")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    ar_records: list[CompanyArRecord]
